tools.name: search_cuts
tools.description: Search Digital Gemology's gem cuts and Platonic solids by name, style, shape or use (for example 'square step cut', 'round brilliant for moissanite', 'historic cushion', 'pear'). Returns each match with its page, facets, size, price and checkout links. Give a gemstone to add the cut's brilliance, fi

tools.name: get_cut
tools.description: Everything about one cut: what it is, measured specifications (facets, angles, depth, size, index gear), brilliance, fire and scintillation in all seven gemstones against the T73, the products with prices and checkout links, its questions and answers, and its page.

tools.name: best_cuts_for_gemstone
tools.description: The top ten brilliants and the top ten jewelry cuts in one gemstone, ranked by brilliance, fire and scintillation added together, with the stone's optical constants.

tools.name: cut_in_gemstone
tools.description: How one cut performs in one gemstone: its headline, eight measured scores against the T73 round brilliant in the same stone, and its pros and cons. For questions like 'is an oval a good cut for sapphire?'.

tools.name: list_gemstones
tools.description: The seven gemstones every cut is measured in, with refractive index, critical angle, dispersion, hardness and specific gravity, and the three best cuts of each kind.

tools.name: get_cut_scores
tools.description: Scores from the Digital Gemology Cut Performance Index for every cut we sell: overall, brilliance, fire, scintillation, tilt, symmetry, spread, shape-norm and leakage, ray traced separately in diamond, moissanite, cubic zirconia, ruby, sapphire, emerald and amethyst, with each cut's place in its mat

tools.name: compare_cuts
tools.description: Two cuts side by side in one gemstone: overall, brilliance, fire, scintillation, tilt, face-up spread and leakage from the Cut Performance Index, each cut's place in that stone, facets and size, and the products with prices and checkout links. For questions like 'oval or pear for my sapphire?'.

tools.name: recommend_cut
tools.description: The best cuts in one gemstone for what matters to the buyer: overall light performance, brilliance, fire, scintillation (sparkle), spread (looks bigger for its weight), tilt (stays bright when tilted) or leakage (least light lost).
